top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information obtained throughout the investigation shows that caregivers did not promptly change a child's soiled diaper, resulting in a rash.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Four children files were missing vaccinations, one child file was missing a health statement, one child file was missing the permission to have medical treatment, one child was missing start date,and  one child file was missing the address for pick up persons.  During the follow up inspection, children's files were missing immunizations.

top_violation_types.title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Information gathered by the CCI through interview and observation on 7/17/2023 showed that several children stated a caregiver was pulling their arm and it's hurting them.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.
